C1437.title: Research on EIP-1559 Base Fee Manipulation
C1437.summary: A 2023 study used game-theoretic and simulation analysis to examine Ethereum's EIP-1559 base-fee mechanism. Under model assumptions such as stable transaction demand, miners controlling part of the hash power could strategically add transactions to affect block congestion and later base fees. The paper also analyzed incentives for other miners to join the strategy and did not claim that a specific on-chain attack had occurred.
